metadata_isolation.notes: Every map record, including permissions, NPC definitions/positions, warps, cameras, scene/overlay mapping and dimensions, is identical. Overworld nodes, events, independent switch scene mappings, player/NPC actor mappings and character metadata are unchanged.

texture_isolation.notes: RGBA16 texture memory is width*height*2 before optional mip overhead, not PNG file size. Material count and largest tile are recorded per changed mesh. Final cleanup removed 46 obsolete physical PNGs, all proven absent from current mesh references; retained prior PNGs are byte-identical.

scope_note: Model/texture asset isolation only; native visual QA, collision tests and measured runtime performance are separate validation gates.

visual_footprint_exceptions.change: Extend south end by 0.30 unit to join the L-counter without a gap.
Move left/right centers 0.60 unit outward, from 5.65/8.35 to 5.05/8.95, so seat caps protrude past the table instead of hiding underneath. Z centers 13.65/16.35 and radius 0.35 unchanged.

final_generation_note: Final regenerated assets include the stool visibility correction. Every metadata isolation and unchanged-mesh SHA check was rerun afterward, including retained texture hashes and absence of references to pruned textures.
